examples.title: Example 1: Configuring an Exception Prompt
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure an exception prompt, including the exception icon, text, margin, and the text content of the right-side icon button.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting a Dialog-Type Exception Prompt
examples.description: This example uses a custom dialog box to set a dialog-type exception prompt.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Symbol Icon
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use symbolStyle in PromptOptions to set custom symbol icons. This functionality is supported since API version 18.
